The PR message claims to use a 'batched charge API with server-side rate limiting', but the diff shows no implementation of batching. The retry loop with 3 attempts is unchanged.

The revisit condition requires Stripe to stabilize response times for batch operations. The PR does not demonstrate that batch operations are now being used, nor does it remove the client-side timeout and concurrency limits that were the workaround.

A dependency bump alone does not resolve the underlying condition. The workaround was added because of client-side timeouts and concurrency issues; simply upgrading the SDK without changing the request pattern or removing the workaround does not address the root cause.
